definition: Disease class of a biopsy taken from its archive folder
main_limitation: Archive class assignment is the routine diagnostic label and not an independent adjudicated gold standard

definition: Distinct persons in a class or subset identified by the archive number prefix
main_limitation: A person contributing repeat biopsies is counted once

definition: Distinct biopsy folders
main_limitation: Fifty-five persons hold more than one biopsy so biopsies exceed patients

definition: Electron microscopy frames enumerated under a biopsy folder
main_limitation: Frames per biopsy vary from 2 to 38 so image counts do not track case counts

definition: Mean frames per person within a class
main_limitation: Sensitive to the few biopsies with very many frames

definition: Smallest and largest frame count of any biopsy in a class
main_limitation: Range only; no distribution is published

definition: Person-level assignment at seed 42 in proportions 0.72 / 0.08 / 0.20
where_reported: split summaries and every metric table
main_limitation: Assignment is per person so per-class proportions are approximate for persons whose repeat biopsies disagree

definition: Structural similarity and peak signal-to-noise of the 384 px downsample against the original frame
main_limitation: Thirty sampled frames per class; not a census

definition: Same three measures for the quality-92 JPEG cache against the downsampled frame
main_limitation: Measures cache fidelity only and says nothing about diagnostic sufficiency

definition: Image-level classification metrics on the held-out test subset
main_limitation: Single centre and single service so no external validity is claimed

definition: Macro one-vs-rest area under the ROC and precision-recall curves
main_limitation: AUC is optimistic under strong class imbalance; average precision is the companion measure

definition: Matthews correlation coefficient and Cohen kappa over eleven classes
main_limitation: Both are prevalence-sensitive and not comparable across differently balanced cohorts

definition: Per-class metrics
main_limitation: Rare classes have wide intervals; read with the confidence interval and never alone

definition: Person-clustered bootstrap percentile interval
main_limitation: Resampling is by person so repeat biopsies move together; interval width reflects rare-class scarcity

definition: Brier score negative log-likelihood and expected calibration error before and after temperature scaling
main_limitation: Expected calibration error depends on binning; the balanced variant is reported alongside

definition: Scalar fitted on the meta-calibration subset globally and per class
main_limitation: Fitted on 661 persons so per-class temperatures for rare classes are unstable

definition: Deterministic test-time augmentation sweep
main_limitation: Folds are nested so the sweep is not independent across settings

definition: Soft voting or stacking with a logistic multilayer-perceptron or gradient-boosted meta-learner
main_limitation: Meta-learners are fitted on the meta-calibration subset only

definition: Backbone diversity measures over test predictions
main_limitation: Descriptive; they do not establish that diversity caused any gain

definition: Paired test of the ensemble against the best single backbone
main_limitation: Tests paired discordance only and says nothing about effect size

definition: Confidence cut-off above which a case is auto-reported and below which it is referred
main_limitation: Retrospective simulation on archival images; not a prospective clinical evaluation

definition: Fraction of cases referred and the disease composition of the referred set
main_limitation: Composition is descriptive and driven by class prevalence as much as by difficulty

definition: Frames per second with and without the data-governance layer
main_limitation: Measured on one host with one GPU; not portable to other hardware

definition: Archive number prefix used to group biopsies and images by person
where_reported: Used on the controlled host only
main_limitation: Quasi-identifier; never released and blocked by PRIVACY_AUDIT.py

definition: Archive folder name combining the patient key with the biopsy date
where_reported: Used on the controlled host only
main_limitation: Quasi-identifier carrying an individual-level date; never released and blocked by PRIVACY_AUDIT.py
